single_proposed_experiment.scope: Aksi face-skin branch in an independent diagnostic copy only
single_proposed_experiment.new_art_input: E: newly authored Non-Color local relief permission map; zero is unchanged; no automatic color threshold or unknown-channel substitution
single_proposed_experiment.formula: S_art = S + e*k*E*(1-S); F_test = min(S_art,D); existing palette(F_test) once

inputs.S: existing SDF bright response entering current MIN, range 0..1
inputs.D: existing native combined diffuse entering the same MIN, range 0..1; not pure visibility
inputs.relief_E: artist-controlled small local face-skin region E, range 0..1

single_proposed_experiment.off_state: e=0 or k=0 restores existing SDF input; E=0 preserves each corresponding pixel
single_proposed_experiment.analytical_invariant: F_test <= D; formula reasoning only, not an executed shader test
does_not_fix: Fill light washing out the combined native response
Incorrect UV, light-direction sign or head axes
future_validation: Preview S, E, S_art, D and F_test separately; verify off-state alignment

Reject fragmented facial shape, asymmetry or expression-dependent UV seams; preserve mouth crease, eye features and cavity
